Official Podcast & Show

My Podcast: You Are Not Going to Believe This

Exploring the hidden forces that shape human lives, resilience, and personal transformation.

True Stories, Interviews, Commentary & Research

You Are Not Going to Believe This

You Are Not Going to Believe This explores the forces that shape our lives—from poverty and privilege to resilience, relationships, education, opportunity, and survival. Every story asks the same question: What helps people build a better life? Through real-life stories, interviews, commentary, and research, we examine the different forms of capital that influence success, struggle, and social mobility. Whether the topic is foster care, higher education, entrepreneurship, trauma, crime, or personal transformation, this channel explores how people overcome obstacles, create opportunity, and rewrite their futures.

Foster Care Higher Education Social Mobility & Capital Trauma & Resilience
